P06: Hello all,. Please how do you go about the issue of wide data gap in visualization?. For instance, I want to show number of suicides per country, while majority of the values for most countries are in hundreds, countries like China, India are having data in thousands, and tens of thousands.. How do you go about scaling this on your axis?
P04: What type of visualisation are you using!
P01: Which visual are u using?
P04: I will advise you use a Scatter plot and make the x-axis logarithmic scale.
P06: A line chart, cos it's over a period
P04: You will also need the country's population for the size of the bubble.
P03: Line chart wouldn't be the best as far power BI is concerned, Tableau could have done synced dual visualisation to make it look appreciable but not Power BI in that regard. Better to use scatter plot like #@전번# rightly said.
P01: He may need country population
P04: Yeah.... Tableau will handle it seemlessly. You can handle add a year filter and play the visualisation to see the trend per year. I dunno if PowerBI latest update was enhanced to handle this type of visualisation (bubble size increase per country's population).
P03: Yeah, most likely. Or it depends. It depends on what he wants to bring out.. Data in the hands of an analyst is up to him what he wants to paint..
